title: Traces V3 metrics filters: use the metrics DSL from createTraceMetadataFilter, not the search-traces SQL-style filter
answers: How do I add a metadata filter to the trace metrics request on the Traces page?
Why does my trace metadata filter work for search but return wrong counts in the metrics endpoint?
Where is the filter string format for trace metrics built?
How do I filter trace counts by run or logged model ID?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/js/src/experiment-tracking/components/experiment-page/components/traces-v3/hooks/useAssessmentCountMetrics.ts:useAssessmentCountMetrics and hooks/useCountInfo.ts:useCountInfo build the filters array sent to the trace metrics query (POST traces/metrics) for counts, session counts and assessment summaries, scoped by runUuid and loggedModelId.
Rule: Build metrics filters with createTraceMetadataFilter (the metrics DSL, e.g. trace.metadata.`mlflow.modelId` = "<id>"). Row search on the same page uses the search-traces request_metadata filter, which is a separate format; do not reuse one for the other. Push one filter per scope (runUuid as mlflow.sourceRun, loggedModelId as mlflow.modelId) and return undefined when none apply.
Symptom: Metrics requests without the scope filter returned counts for every trace in the experiment, so per-value assessment counts such as correct=false COUNT 6 and correct=true COUNT 6 appeared for a model that only had correct=true traces.
Constraints: The DSL form is only for the metrics endpoint in this hook path. The filter is applied only when the value is truthy; empty runUuid or loggedModelId adds nothing.
applies: Frontend code that adds filters to trace metrics requests on the Traces V3 page.
says: Trace metrics cards show counts for the whole experiment instead of the selected model
Assessment count summaries in the traces view include results from unrelated runs
Filtering traces by run does not update the assessment metric totals on screen
Model evaluation counts display false ratings for a model that has only positive feedback
Trace summary cards show wrong totals when filtering by a specific logged model
search: Frontend requests to the trace metrics endpoint (POST traces/metrics) in useAssessmentCountMetrics.ts:useAssessmentCountMetrics and useCountInfo.ts:useCountInfo on the Traces V3 page must build filters using the createTraceMetadataFilter DSL rather than search-traces SQL-style request_metadata filters. Scopes must push one filter per truthy value, mapping runUuid to mlflow.sourceRun and loggedModelId to mlflow.modelId, returning undefined when none apply. Omitting these filters causes metrics requests to return counts across the entire experiment, producing incorrect assessment totals across runs.
